purpose: Artistic calibration and transfer protocol, separate from interpretation unit tests.

calibration.brief: Original weathered signal flask: offset protective cage and hooked cork distinguish it from a potion. Preserve those relationships while testing glass and metal under one external light.
preserve: Offset cage encloses rather than replaces the flask
calibration.failure_limit: A cleaner outline is not successful if the flask reads as a lantern or generic bottle.

calibration.brief: Original road sentry braced against a gust. Establish support, torso lean, and spear grip before dressing the dummy. No borrowed character silhouette.
calibration.failure_limit: Do not make the pose symmetrical to remove overlaps; judge gesture before finish.

calibration.brief: Original wheeled cargo module with a low closed cab, offset load bed and visible two-point mounts. Establish one coherent volume before expanding a small compatible family.
preserve: Cab belongs to chassis rather than a held object
Load is supported rather than read as a head
calibration.failure_limit: An open frame may clarify support while looking too fragile. Record both effects.

arms: C: these interpretation fixes at a recorded commit
requirements: Record exact commits, model version, tools and budgets for all arms
Record actual reference access and all failed attempts
Judge actual native read before revealing brief; evaluate requirements before preference
Permit tie, uncertainty and both fail; retain per-family regressions
Human owner review remains distinct from builder or independent model review
These visible cases are not a hidden holdout; later verification needs new briefs
No automatic promotion or beauty score; two repetitions are an exploratory pilot
